Subject: Re: shipping tool, what Priya needs

Hi both,

Quick list of what the warehouse team told me, in no order:

must print the packing slip and the label with one click
must show stock per shelf, not just per product
needs to work on the handheld scanners (Android, small screen)
every order needs an audit trail: who packed it and when
fast. picking a list of 50 lines should not take more than a second to load
nice to have: dark mode

> Dave wrote earlier:
> the tool should cope with 10 orders an hour

No, that was last year. We now do about 400 orders an hour at peak and it has to cope with
double that.

The scanner app must keep working when the wifi drops in the cold store and send what was
scanned once it is back.

Thanks,
Ines
